candidates.locator: page 28, section fact_sheet, APPLICABLE WATER QUALITY-BASED LIMITS formula

candidates.computation_change_reason: Core WQBEL calculation tying criteria (Cs), ambient (Ca), mixing fraction (F), and flows (Qa, Qe) to enforceable daily and monthly limits; any input interpretation change alters computed limits.
